title: Fourier weight up to degree k
statement: Let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ take only the values $0$ and $1$, and let its mean be $\alpha$. If $k$ is a positive integer satisfying $k\le 2\log(1/\alpha)$, then the sum of the squared Fourier coefficients of $f$ over all subsets of coordinates of size at most $k$ is at most $\left(\frac{2e}{k}\log\frac{1}{\alpha}\right)^k\alpha^2$.
